title: OpenToM: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Evaluating Theory-of-Mind Reasoning Capabilities of Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It is designed to evaluate the Theory-of-Mind (ToM) reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models, focusing on characters' mental states in physical and psychological contexts through narratives involving everyday social interactions.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as this was not a focus of the study.
